introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the left, keeping shoulders grounded. 

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.
name: LYING TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your body. Exhale to deepen the twist.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the right, keeping shoulders grounded.

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. 

Put your arms straight over your head. 

Slide your forearms down at 90 degree angles, then slide them up. Repeat the exercise.
name: FLOOR SLIDES

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your elbows and wrists always on the floor.
Slide your arms up as high as possible without letting your lower back off the floor.
Take a deep breath in as you slide your arms up towards your head.
Exhale slowly as you slide your arms back down towards your sides.

introduce: Lie on your back with your toes towards the ceiling, legs flat on the floor and arms straight overhead. \n\nSwing your legs to your right and hold this position.
name: LYING SWING LEGS LEFT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie on your back with your toes towards the ceiling, legs flat on the floor and arms straight overhead. \n\nSwing your legs to your left and hold this position.
name: LYING SWING LEGS RIGHT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your right knee, and grab the back of your right thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your right ankle on your left knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your left knee, and grab the back of your left thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Lie down on the floor in complete relaxation with your legs straight.

Inhale as you extend your arms overhead, letting them fall naturally and opening through your shoulders. Exhale, allow your body to settle and relax deeper into the floor.

Hold the position, feeling your body stretch fully with each inhale and exhale.
name: EXTENDED RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Feel the support of the earth on your back.
Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale fully to relax and deepen the stretch.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs bent, and feet flat on the mat, shoulder-width apart. Inhale and raise your arms overhead.\n\nAlternate tilting your legs to the left and right. Repeat the exercise.
name: SUPINE WINDSHIELD WIPERS

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Breathe regularly.
This exercise can relax your lower back and hips.
